name: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
headline: Headroom compresses tool outputs before they reach the LLM
lede: You can shrink logs, JSON, files and RAG chunks before the model sees them, as a library, proxy or MCP server.

effects.effect: Lower token cost for long tool-heavy sessions

appearances.summary: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
